home.title: GHORA GHURI - Tours, Treks & Heritage across Bangladesh
home.meta_description: Custom itineraries, fixed departures and guide-led expeditions across Bangladesh.

hero_slides.title: Mangrove tigers, ridge-top clouds and a 120 km sea beach
hero_slides.subtitle: GHORA GHURI is a Khulna-based agency running fixed-departure tours and private itineraries across all eight divisions - with the boat, permit and guide work handled before you arrive.

hero_slides.title: Cox's Bazar, Inani, Himchari and St. Martin's
hero_slides.subtitle: Midweek departures from Khulna, Dhaka or the airport, with beachfront hotels, guide support and the coral-island launch booked in one place.

hero_slides.title: Srimangal tea gardens and the Chittagong Hill Tracts
hero_slides.subtitle: Cycle between estates, walk Lawachara's canopy, then trek Chandraket for the cloud line - a four-day loop built for photographers and slow travellers.

hero_slides.title: Paharpur, Mahasthangarh, Bagerhat and old Dhaka
hero_slides.subtitle: Two UNESCO sites, three sultanate cities and a guided Mughal-fort morning - north Bengal done properly with an archaeology-trained guide.

home.highlights_subtitle: Built from Khulna, running journeys across all 8 divisions with verified local hosts.

sundarban_banner.title: Sundarbans Expedition Specialists
sundarban_banner.subtitle: Direct forest permits, certified naturalist rangers, silent electric launches in restricted zones, and private boat charters embarking weekly from Khulna and Mongla.

testimonials.quote: Three days in the Sundarbans with two kids - the boat crew knew exactly where the deer come out at dusk. The permit paperwork was already done when we reached Noapara.

testimonials.quote: We asked for a north-Bengal heritage loop in one email and got a day-by-day plan with Paharpur, Mahasthangarh, Kantajiu and Puthia in under 24 hours. Guide was a postgraduate archaeologist.
testimonials.author: Andrew S.

testimonials.quote: Booked Kuakata for 14 colleagues. Two buses, one hotel block, sunrise on the beach, zero confusion, and the taka quote did not move.
testimonials.author: Mahmudul H.

about.title: About GHORA GHURI - guide-led tours run from Khulna
about.mission_statement: To make every corner of Bangladesh accessible, authentic, and sustainable through locally-anchored guiding and transparent pricing.
about.founder_bio: Born in Khulna, Mashzidul founded GHORA GHURI to bridge the gap between discerning domestic/international travelers and grassroots heritage guardians across Bangladesh.
story_paragraphs: Starting with small boat charters into the southern Sundarban channels, GHORA GHURI expanded over five years into a full-service travel operating company with direct relationships with licensed boatmasters, village homestead hosts, and archaeology scholars.
Today, our network covers all 64 districts with verified field coordinators, ensuring zero hidden costs, prompt permits, and respect for local ecosystems.
